author: Lawrance Dent
text: Clinton is outstanding! I was lucky enough to get same day service. He is friendly and fair. Had my clogged sewer line free in no time. I highly recommend Clinton and turdbusters.

author: Tonya M
text: The gentleman came to my home and looked at my sisters septic and could have told me anything, I know nothing about them. He was here when he said he would be,  was honest by telling me he couldn't fix the problem.. but have me the name and number of another company that came right out and fixed it,  and it was 1/4 of the process others have given.  So thank you for your quick response and information.. and for pointing me in the right direction.

author: Shelley M
text: Clinton answered when I called and was able to come out within just a few hours. He fixed my problem and took the time to educate me on my system and how to troubleshoot potential issues. As a new homeowner, that knowledge was invaluable. Could not ask for better service. Would recommend to anyone with plumbing issues.
